title: EU and Canada conclude negotiations for a Digital Trade Agreement
excerpt: Leaders meeting in Montréal launched the Alliance for the Future during the EU-Canada Summit 2026.
bodyHtml:
According to the European Commission, the EU and Canada concluded negotiations for a Digital Trade Agreement on October 31, 2026. The announcement follows the EU-Canada Summit 2026 hosted by Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney in Montréal, where European Council President António Costa and Commission President Ursula von der Leyen took part.

During the summit, the EU and Canada launched the Alliance for the Future. The European Commission described the Alliance as a common space for growth, prosperity, resilience and economic security.

The European Commission stated that the Digital Trade Agreement will complement the success of CETA, the EU-Canada free trade agreement. Additionally, an agreement between Canada and the European Investment Bank on investment in critical raw materials is being finalised.
topic: EU-Canada Summit 2026: Leaders mark a historic moment in bilateral relations
